data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What the best recipe for making chocolate chip cookies? ASSISTANT:

One of the best recipes for making chocolate chip cookies is the classic version from the American cooking website, Allrecipes.com. This recipe calls for 1 cup of butter, 1 cup of sugar, 2 eggs, 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, 1 cup of flour, 1 teaspoon of baking soda, and 1 cup of semi-sweet chocolate chips. The cookies are baked for 12 minutes at 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
